summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules, reporting the cancellation of 6,469,787 Class A ordinary shares (underlying ADSs) repurchased from May 20 to July 6, 2026. This reduces total issued shares (excluding treasury) from 563,800,693 to 557,330,906, a 0.84% decrease. The repurchases were open-market buybacks at undisclosed prices, subsequently cancelled. No premium, tender premium, or advisor is named. The filing confirms board authorization and compliance with listing rules. This is an ongoing buyback-and-cancel program, effectively returning capital to shareholders. Watch for further repurchase activity and potential EPS accretion.
